AccountUnresolved.zhs: 无法解析账号或其当前部门。对象保留待补齐，请人工选择具有部门归属的账号。
AccountUnresolved.en: The account or its current department cannot be resolved. Choose an account with a department to initialize this object.

AlreadyOwned.zhs: 已有所属人不能通过补齐改变，请保留当前所属人。
AlreadyOwned.en: Initialization cannot change an existing owner. Keep the current owner.

TargetUnavailable.zhs: 对象不存在或当前不可读取，请重新选择。
TargetUnavailable.en: The object is unavailable or unreadable. Select it again.

EditDenied.zhs: 当前没有此对象的编辑资格，未补齐归属。
EditDenied.en: You cannot edit this object. Ownership was not initialized.

InvalidSelection.zhs: 请选择非空且不重复的真实对象集合。
InvalidSelection.en: Select a nonempty set of distinct objects.

InvalidPage.zhs: 页码无效，请重新读取待补齐列表。
InvalidPage.en: The page is invalid. Reload the pending list.
